package http_test

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// 生成 kite tests/go/testdata/http/mux.txt。行格式：new（新 mux）、pat|模式、req|方法|Host|URL（十六进制）。
func TestDumpMux(t *testing.T) {
	var out []string
	h := func(s string) string { return hex.EncodeToString([]byte(s)) }
	newMux := func() { out = append(out, "new") }
	pat := func(s string) { out = append(out, "pat|"+h(s)) }
	req := func(m, host, u string) { out = append(out, "req|"+h(m)+"|"+h(host)+"|"+h(u)) }
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	lits := func(file, fn string, n int) [][]string {
		f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, file, nil, 0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var res [][]string
		for _, d := range f.Decls {
			fd, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl)
			if !ok || fd.Name.Name != fn {
				continue
			}
			ast.Inspect(fd, func(x ast.Node) bool {
				cl, ok := x.(*ast.CompositeLit)
				if !ok || len(cl.Elts) < n {
					return true
				}
				var row []string
				for _, e := range cl.Elts[:n] {
					b, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
					if !ok || b.Kind != token.STRING {
						return true
					}
					s, _ := strconv.Unquote(b.Value)
					row = append(row, s)
				}
				res = append(res, row)
				return true
			})
		}
		return res
	}
	for _, r := range lits("pattern_test.go", "TestParsePattern", 1) {
		newMux()
		pat(r[0])
	}
	for _, r := range lits("pattern_test.go", "TestParsePatternError", 1) {
		newMux()
		pat(r[0])
	}
	for _, fn := range []string{"TestConflictsWith", "TestDescribeConflict", "TestCommonPath", "TestDifferencePath"} {
		for _, r := range lits("pattern_test.go", fn, 2) {
			newMux()
			pat(r[0])
			pat(r[1])
			newMux()
			pat(r[1])
			pat(r[0])
		}
	}
	newMux()
	for _, p := range []string{"/a", "/a/b", "/a/{x}", "/g/h/i", "/g/{x}/j", "/a/b/{x...}", "/a/b/{y}", "/a/b/{$}"} {
		pat(p)
	}
	for _, r := range lits("routing_tree_test.go", "TestRoutingNodeMatch", 3) {
		req(r[0], r[1], r[2])
	}
	newMux()
	for _, e := range serveMuxRegister {
		pat(e.pattern)
	}
	for _, tt := range serveMuxTests {
		req(tt.method, tt.host, tt.path)
	}
	for _, tt := range serveMuxTests2 {
		req(tt.method, tt.host, tt.url)
	}
	for _, x := range muxExtra {
		switch x[0] {
		case "new":
			newMux()
		case "pat":
			pat(x[1])
		case "req":
			req(x[1], x[2], x[3])
		}
	}
	os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("OUT"), []byte(strings.Join(out, "\n")+"\n"), 0o644)
}

var muxExtra = [][]string{
	{"new"}, {"pat", "GET /items/{id}"}, {"pat", "POST /items/{id}"}, {"pat", "DELETE /items/{id}/{rest...}"},
	{"pat", "/files/{path...}"}, {"pat", "GET /exact/{$}"}, {"pat", "example.com/"}, {"pat", "GET example.com/items/{id}"},
	{"pat", "/old/"}, {"pat", "/static/"}, {"pat", "HEAD /h"}, {"pat", "GET /g"}, {"pat", "/b/{name}/x"}, {"pat", "PUT /items/{id}"},
	{"pat", "/items/{id}"}, {"pat", "GET /items/{x}"}, {"pat", "/files/"}, {"pat", "GET /a b"}, {"pat", "/%41/{v}"},
	{"req", "GET", "h.com", "/items/42"}, {"req", "POST", "h.com", "/items/42"}, {"req", "PATCH", "h.com", "/items/42"},
	{"req", "HEAD", "h.com", "/items/42"}, {"req", "DELETE", "h.com", "/items/42/a/b%2Fc"}, {"req", "DELETE", "h.com", "/items/42"},
	{"req", "GET", "h.com", "/files/a/b/c"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/files/"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/files"},
	{"req", "GET", "h.com", "/exact/"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/exact/x"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/exact"},
	{"req", "GET", "example.com", "/items/7"}, {"req", "GET", "example.com:8080", "/items/7"}, {"req", "POST", "example.com", "/items/7"},
	{"req", "GET", "example.com", "/whatever"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/old"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/old?q=1&r"},
	{"req", "GET", "h.com", "/static/../old/x"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/a/./b/../static/"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "//static//x"},
	{"req", "HEAD", "h.com", "/h"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/h"}, {"req", "HEAD", "h.com", "/g"}, {"req", "POST", "h.com", "/g"},
	{"req", "POST", "h.com", "/h"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/b/%E4%B8%AD/x"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/b/a%2Fb/x"},
	{"req", "GET", "h.com", "/A/1"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/%41/1"}, {"req", "GET", "h.com", "/nope"},
	{"req", "CONNECT", "h.com:443", "h.com:443"}, {"req", "CONNECT", "h.com", "/files/x"}, {"req", "CONNECT", "h.com", "/old"},
	{"req", "GET", "[::1]:80", "/items/1"}, {"req", "GET", "bad:host:x", "/items/1"},
	{"new"}, {"pat", "/"}, {"pat", "/a/"}, {"pat", "GET /a/{x}/"}, {"pat", "/a/{x}/{y...}"},
	{"req", "GET", "", "/"}, {"req", "GET", "", "/a"}, {"req", "GET", "", "/a/b"}, {"req", "GET", "", "/a/b/"}, {"req", "POST", "", "/a/b/"},
	{"req", "GET", "", "/a/b/c/d"}, {"req", "GET", "", ""}, {"req", "GET", "", "x"},
	{"new"}, {"pat", "POST /only"}, {"pat", "PUT /only/"}, {"req", "GET", "", "/only"}, {"req", "GET", "", "/only/"},
	{"req", "DELETE", "", "/only/x"},
	{"new"}, {"pat", "CONNECT h.com:443/"}, {"pat", "CONNECT /x/../y"}, {"pat", "GET /x/../y"}, {"pat", "GET /x/"}, {"pat", "GET //x"},
}
